actions.name: Measure chain wear
actions.limits_source: 12-speed: replace at 0.5 % (shop guidance, e.g. Shimano TL-CN42 drops in); 0.4 % warning is a personal margin

actions.name: Measure pad material
actions.limits_source: Shimano: replace before the pad material is under 0.5 mm; 1.0 mm is the practical warning point (Shimano tune-up guide)

actions.name: Measure rotor thickness
actions.limits_source: Shimano rotors: 1.8 mm new, replace at 1.5 mm (printed on the rotor); check yours

actions.name: Inspect brake hoses and caliper (leaks, kinks)
Check pulley wheels (play, worn teeth, noise)
Check chainring wear (teeth shape, chain suck)
Check quick link (closes with a firm snap, not loose)
Check rim tape (tubeless: leaks at spoke holes)
Check cassette wear (teeth, skipping with the new chain)
Check bottom bracket (play, creaks, rough bearings)
Check shift cable and housing (fraying, friction)
Torque check (stem, bars, seatpost, cranks, rotors, thru-axles)
Frame and fork inspection (cracks, dents, chips)
Di2 check in E-TUBE (firmware, error log)
Full service (whole bike)
checklist: Wheel hub bearings: play and roughness
Brakes: bleed (or check lever feel), hoses, pads, rotors
Di2 wires and junction / shift cables and housing
Frame and fork: cracks, dents, chips
Drivetrain: deep clean, chain, cassette and chainring wear

default_rules.name: Inspect tire
default_rules.notes: Yearly also for sidewall cracks from age; no bicycle-tire age limit was found.

default_rules.name: Top up sealant
default_rules.notes: Stan's: sealant lasts 2–6 months; check every 3 months (stans.com sealant support).

default_rules.name: Clean out and renew sealant
default_rules.notes: Stan's: take the tire off and clean out old sealant once a year; check rim tape and valves at the same time (stans.com sealant support).

default_rules.name: Replace valve core
default_rules.notes: At the yearly sealant clean-out; personal value.

default_rules.name: Check and grease thru-axle
default_rules.notes: Personal value.

default_rules.name: Check and grease thru-axle
default_rules.notes: Personal value.

default_rules.name: Charge Di2 battery
default_rules.notes: Shimano BT-DN300: about 1000 km per charge (less with much front shifting); 800 km leaves a margin. Source: retailer listings (Rose, Tweeks), not verified with Shimano.

default_rules.name: Charge power meter
default_rules.notes: Set to your power meter's battery life with a margin.

default_rules.name: Charge power-meter pedals
default_rules.notes: Favero Assioma PRO RS-1: at least 60 h per charge (up to about 160 h after a firmware update). 80 h is your choice (2026-10-26). Source: retailer listings quoting Favero, not verified.

default_rules.name: Replace sensor battery
default_rules.notes: Magene S3+ (CR2032): about 500 h of riding per battery (retailer listings, not verified with Magene); 400 h leaves a margin. 12 months covers standby drain (your estimate).

default_rules.name: Replace shifter coin cells
default_rules.notes: Wireless Di2 levers (CR1632): about 1.5–2 years (retailer listings); 18 months leaves a margin. Off by default (wired and mechanical levers have no coin cell); switch it on for wireless levers. Keep CR1632 cells as counted stock to pick them when logging.

default_rules.name: Charge bike computer
default_rules.notes: Set to your device's battery life with a margin (personal value).

default_rules.name: Charge light
default_rules.notes: Set to your light's run time in the mode you use (personal value).

default_rules.name: Charge radar
default_rules.notes: Set to your radar's run time in the mode you use (personal value).

default_rules.name: Check pulley wheels
default_rules.notes: Common workshop practice, not a maker's figure.

default_rules.name: Check chainring wear
default_rules.notes: Check at least at every chain change; common practice, not a maker's figure.

default_rules.name: Replace quick link
default_rules.notes: Wippermann Connex links are sold as reusable many times; no official limit was found. Replace after 2 chains (your choice) or as soon as it closes noticeably looser than new.

default_rules.name: Check rim tape
default_rules.notes: Check at every tire change or yearly (tubes: tape covers the spoke holes; tubeless: it seals).

default_rules.name: Inspect brake hoses and caliper
default_rules.notes: With every fluid change or yearly; personal value.

default_rules.name: Bed in new pads
default_rules.notes: Once after fitting; after 100 km without it the pads count as bedded in.

default_rules.name: Bed in new rotor
default_rules.notes: Once after fitting; after 100 km without it the rotor counts as bedded in.

default_rules.name: Service pedal bearings
default_rules.notes: Rider figure, not a maker's interval.

default_rules.name: Service pedal bearings
default_rules.notes: No Favero interval found; riders regrease Assioma pedals about yearly or every 2,500 km.

default_rules.name: Check bottom bracket
default_rules.notes: Personal value.

default_rules.name: Inspect bar tape
default_rules.notes: Personal value.

default_rules.name: Re-paste seatpost
default_rules.notes: Stops a seatpost from seizing; personal value.

default_rules.name: Check derailleur hanger
default_rules.notes: Also after every crash; personal value.

default_rules.name: Inspect cleats
default_rules.notes: Replace when a wear pad is worn through or clipping feels different, often about 6,000 km (rider figure; BikeRadar).

default_rules.name: Check shift cable
default_rules.notes: Personal value.

default_rules.name: Check shift housing
default_rules.notes: Personal value.

default_rules.name: Torque check
default_rules.notes: Every 3 months and once after the first ride on a newly fitted part (personal value). Torque values come from each product's spec (torque_nm) where you entered it.

default_rules.name: Di2 check (firmware, errors)
default_rules.notes: Firmware is updated with Shimano E-TUBE; 6 months is a personal value.

default_rules.name: Inspect Di2 wires
default_rules.notes: Personal value.

default_rules.name: Yearly full service
default_rules.notes: Once a year, a full service of the whole bike: Wheel hub bearings: play and roughness; Headset: clean, grease, check play; Bottom bracket: play and noise; Brakes: bleed (or check lever feel), hoses, pads, rotors; Di2 wires and junction / shift cables and housing; Frame and fork: cracks, dents, chips; Drivetrain: deep clean, chain, cassette and chainring wear; Pedals: bearing play; Torque check of all bolts. Personal value; each job keeps its own reminder.
